meta_description:
5,347 likes, 126 comments - delhitravelblogger on September 14, 2026: "East Delhi mein ek lake hai jahan 90 species ke birds aate hain — aur zyada logon ko iske baare mein pata hi nahi 🦆🌿

Ye hai Sanjay Lake, Trilokpuri — DDA ne 1982 mein Yamuna aur Hindon river ke back-flow se banaya tha ye artificial lake. 42 acres ka lake, 170 acres ke green forest ke beech — Delhi ke sabse peaceful spots mein se ek.

Boating bhi try kar sakte ho, ya bas shaam ko yahan chill karne aa jao — no crowd, pure nature 🚣

📍 Trilokpuri, East Delhi (Mayur Vihar II ke paas)
🕙 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM, daily (no weekly off)
🎟️ Entry free | Boating ~₹130/person (20 min)

📱 Shot on iPhone 16 Pro".
